title.narrative: OEGI - Resilience Learning Activity (RLA) Associate Award#3

description.narrative: (Kenya): Using FY 2022 funding, USAID will continue its support for the Resilience Learning Activity (RLA). RLA is an Associate Award under the Feed the Future Kenya Livestock Market Systems Activity, a Leader with Associates (LWA) contracting mechanism, held by ACDI/VOCA. .The goal of RLA is to strengthen county and national government capacity for data analytics for evidence-based decision making. Further, RLA facilitates learning for adaptive management, improves knowledge management, and strengthens communication to align with USAID goals and the Government of Kenya's (GOK) Ending Drought Emergencies (EDE) Strategy. ..RLA will advance USAID's localization approach by partnering with nine local organizations and county and national government partners to provide technical assistance for disaster risk management and collaboration, learning, and adapting (CLA) training to monitor and adapt programs across all development partners. The activity will also ensure that resilience principles are incorporated into county government transition plans and new county government County Development Implementation Plans (CIDPs). Specific sub-activities include: 1) drought emergency response and mitigation mapping; 2) indicator alignment between USAID and GOK reporting requirements; 3) social behavior change communication; 4) knowledge fairs; and 5) facilitating resilience partners to sequence, layer and integrate resilience interventions in the resilience focus zones..
